name: Wallet Ready Gift Cards for SureCart By GiftRocketWP
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
GiftRocket adds real gift cards to your SureCart store. Customers design a card, pick an amount, and send it now or on a date they choose. Recipients spend it at checkout, and any unused balance stays on the card for next time.

Unlike coupon workarounds, every GiftRocket card has its own balance and transaction history. Your SureCart › Coupons list stays clean.

What you can do

  • Sell gift cards from any SureCart product. Turn on the GiftRocket Wizard in the product editor and set preset amounts, custom amounts, expiry and terms. No shortcodes needed.
  • Let shoppers design the card. A live preview updates as they choose a design, amount and message. Includes Birthday, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Valentine’s and general designs, plus optional customer artwork uploads.
  • Deliver instantly or on a schedule. Send by email straight after payment, or on the date and time the buyer picks — perfect for birthdays and holidays.
  • Spend part of a balance. If the order is smaller than the card, the rest stays on the card. If it’s larger, the customer pays the difference by card or PayPal.
  • A separate gift card field at checkout. A “Have a gift card?” panel sits next to SureCart’s coupon field, with a live balance badge and one-click remove.
  • Apple Wallet and Google Wallet pass designer. Connect Epasscard and design wallet pass templates in the dashboard, with a live phone preview, your brand colours and logo, and QR, Code 128, PDF417 or Aztec barcodes. Use one design store-wide or a custom design per product. Requires an Epasscard account.
  • Full balance history. Every issue, redemption, manual adjustment and refund is recorded in an add-only ledger you can view per card.
  • Refunds handled for you. When an order paid with a gift card is refunded or cancelled, the spent amount goes back onto the card. If the order that bought a card is revoked, the card is disabled.
  • Manage cards in one place. Create, edit, resend, adjust balances and change status (Active, Used, Expired, Disabled). Import cards from CSV and export outstanding balances.
  • Balance checker page. Add [giftrocket_balance_check] to any page so customers can check their balance, original value, status and expiry.
  • Built-in safeguards. Database row locking stops a card being spent twice at the same moment, and repeated wrong codes are rate-limited.
  • Translation-ready. All customer-facing text can be translated, and the customizer headings and labels can be edited from the settings.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or later and PHP 7.4 or later.
  • The free SureCart plugin, installed and connected.
  • Optional: an Epasscard account for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes.

Privacy and external services

GiftRocket stores gift card data in your own WordPress database. It only contacts an external service if you choose to connect Epasscard (api.epasscard.com) for wallet passes. When you connect, your name, email and site name are sent to create or validate your Epasscard account, and the pass templates you design (colours, logo, field mapping) are sent to Epasscard. Please review Epasscard’s terms and privacy policy before connecting.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins › Add New, search for “GiftRocket SureCart”, then install and activate. (Or upload the ZIP via Plugins › Add New › Upload Plugin.)
  2. Make sure SureCart is installed and active.
  3. Edit a product in SureCart › Products and open the 🎁 GiftRocket Wizard to set amounts, expiry, scheduling and terms.
  4. Go to GiftRocket in the admin menu to manage cards, designs, email and settings.
  5. Optional: create a page with [giftrocket_balance_check] so customers can check their balance.
  6. Optional: go to GiftRocket › Epasscard Settings to connect wallet passes.
sections.faq:
Does this require SureCart?

Yes. GiftRocket is built for SureCart products and checkout. It shows a notice and stays inactive if SureCart isn’t active.

Does GiftRocket support Apple Wallet and Google Wallet?

Yes, through Epasscard. Connect your Epasscard account, then design your pass templates store-wide or per product under GiftRocket › Epasscard Settings.

Do I need an Epasscard account?

Only for wallet passes. Connect an existing Epasscard API key, or register from GiftRocket › Epasscard Settings. Gift cards, emails and checkout work without it.

Can different gift card products use different pass designs?

Yes. Each gift card product has a “Digital Pass (Epasscard)” tab where you can use the store-wide template or set a custom design.

Will this add lots of codes to my SureCart Coupons list?

No. Gift cards live in their own tables. During checkout GiftRocket creates a temporary SureCart code so payment gateways see the discount, and deletes it as soon as the order is confirmed or the card is removed. An hourly clean-up removes any left behind.

Do I need to use shortcodes?

Not for products. Any SureCart product set to “GiftRocket Gift Card” shows the customizer automatically. The [giftrocket_balance_check] shortcode is optional, for a balance checker page.

How do customers check their balance?

At checkout in the “Have a gift card?” panel, or on any page with the [giftrocket_balance_check] shortcode.

Can a card be used across several orders?

Yes. Whatever isn’t spent stays on the card for future orders.

Can I add my own card designs?

Yes. Under GiftRocket › Designs you can add your own designs and occasion badges using the WordPress Media Library.

How are gift cards delivered?

By branded HTML email, either straight after payment or at the date and time the buyer chooses.

Why did a scheduled email arrive a few minutes late?

Scheduled delivery uses WP-Cron, which runs when your site gets visits. On low-traffic sites, set up a real server cron job for exact timing. A safety check also runs every 5 minutes.

Where can I get help?

Post in the support forum. We read every thread.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 – 2026-10-15

  • New: Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes through Epasscard.
  • New: Wallet pass designer with a live phone preview.
  • New: Per-product pass designs in the SureCart product editor.
  • New: QR, Code 128, PDF417 and Aztec barcodes.
  • New: Sync and map existing Epasscard templates.
  • Improved: Responsive layout inside the SureCart admin.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Gift card engine with its own balance, ledger and log tables, keeping SureCart › Coupons clean.
  • Add-only transaction ledger for every issue, redemption, adjustment and refund.
  • Temporary checkout codes that are removed once the order is confirmed or the card is removed.
  • Live customizer with card preview, preset amounts and multiple designs.
  • Admin card management: create, edit, adjust balances and set status.
  • Scheduled delivery to the minute, with a 5-minute safety queue and UTC date handling.
  • Scheduled Deliveries view with filters, counts and search.
  • Guest checkout, row locking against double spending, and balance restoration on refunds.
